claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.create_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The core payload is creating a persistent fortress object in play, not granting a creature effect. The v4 taxonomy already names create_object, but the current surface and tracer do not expose it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower

claude_proposed_widenings.name: persistent_object_state_and_commanded_opening
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The tower keeps independent durability across activations, can revert only while empty, and has a door that opens on later bonus-action commands. That is persistent object state, not a one-shot direct effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: which works only if the tower is empty ... The door opens only at your command, which you can issue as a Bonus Action ... Shrinking the tower back down to statuette form doesn't repair damage to the tower
